name: Second chance offer: box under price (archived)

who.value: seller whose auction ended below reserve

job.value: Offer the card again to bidders via a box under the price on the listing page

arrivedFrom.value: the Updates notification about the unmet reserve

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The notification 'Your reserve price ... wasn't met — Choose your price and offer it to everyone who bid' is clear, but the first screen shows the Updates entry, not the listing-page box this archived option is about.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Offer to bidders >' link with the '2d 18h left' timer is the clearest action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Offer to bidders' says what will happen.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Reserve price' is the seller's own setting.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Whether to make an offer is a decision the seller can take now.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only a headline, one line and a timer.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The notification lands right after the auction closed.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Bold title and one short line carry it.
